Standing up for those without a voice, our mission is to rescue, rehabilitate and to spread awareness of farm animals in need. Aimee's Farm Animal Sanctuary is a 501(c)(3) non-profit home to 100+ sentient beings in sunny Queen Creek, Arizona!
